notes.title: 🧟‍♀️💦 Hotfix for the horny and the undead!
notes.content:
[h3]We’ve squashed a few bugs that were haunting some of you survivors:

🗓️ Daily achievements now unlock like they’re supposed to
⭐ Stars finally shine bright again (just like your eyes after a steamy night in the bunker)
📜 Quests no longer skip ahead like they’ve got a mind of their own
🗡️ Katana bug seems gone — but if it acts up again, slice first, ask questions later

Thanks for sticking with us in this filthy, freaky apocalypse! 💋

— With love,
BanzaiProject Studio[/h3]
